tablets.title: the Verse of the Manger
tablets.after: Every feeding trough in the parish has been attended to personally.
tablets.said: The faithful should welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: spelled out exactly how binding it is
steps.text: The faithful are advised, though not ordered, to welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: heard "mangers" for "strangers"
steps.text: The faithful are advised, though not ordered, to welcome mangers with kindness.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: The faithful are advised, though not ordered, to welcome mangers with kindness, having first bought a permit from Aldous.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Oven Gold
tablets.after: Everyone agrees it is a lovely phrase. Nobody has handed over any bread.
tablets.said: The faithful should share their bread with the hungry.

steps.note: took "with the hungry" at its word
steps.text: The faithful should share their bread with whoever is hungriest at the time, to be settled by a show of ribs.

steps.text: Let the faithful share the gold of the oven, under the supervision of Aldous, who is to be paid.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Patient Elm

steps.text: Let the faithful rest beneath the patient elm, by permit, obtainable from Aldous for two eggs.

vars.name: Ysolt
vars.god: the God of Doors That Stick

event.text: Ysolt wants to give you a goat.

ruling.text: A child has asked Odo where you live, and Odo does not know.
ruling.after: The child has asked which one.

chronicle.headdesk: Somewhere above the parish, a small cloud sighs.
chronicle.memo: Welcome to the Lower Annex. You have twelve believers. The Registry considers that a rounding error, but I have seen worse. Not much worse.

line.text: Vellamine has carved a new verse. Her people got it wrong too. It is some comfort.

offices.text: Roesia preached for four minutes and let everyone go early. It is the most popular thing the temple has ever done.

chronicle.headdesk: You make a sound that, at your level, registers as weather.
chronicle.memo: The stonemason asked me whether it was meant to say that. I said it was now.

line.text: Vellamine has read your Scripture and called it brave.

offices.text: Umfrey is your Prophet. They will pass on the important parts, as they see them.

chronicle.headdesk: You rest your forehead on the edge of a cloud for a while.
chronicle.memo: A new Tablet. It will outlive everyone who carved it, including, possibly, you.

line.text: Vellamine's newest Tablet says something about lamps. Nobody can agree what.

offices.text: Brenna did the rounds of the alehouse and came home with new believers, none of whom remember agreeing.
Ysolt's work comes in larger and dearer than asked, with Ysolt's name over the door in larger letters than yours.

chronicle.headdesk: You ask Pim whether all gods have this problem. Pim says yes, and that the large ones have it louder.
chronicle.memo: Year end. The Registry has noted your continued existence and has no further comment at this time.

offices.text: Aldous collects more than anyone ever has. Aldous also has a new hat.
Hesper is your Witness. Whatever you do will be told better than it happened.

chronicle.headdesk: You draft a clarification. Then you remember how clarifications travel.
chronicle.memo: Another verse. You will notice it is not quite what you said. That is normal. That is, in fact, the job.

line.text: Vellamine's miracle was mostly lighting. It worked.

sceneAfter: Aldous chairs the first meeting that evening. It runs until midnight. Heresy is down. So, slightly, is everyone.
